doc: A new activity file holds the binding's template, the header alone (spec 014 research R5). Each list is created at the end of the file with its first entry and removed with its last; a specification's tasks are created after its status. The user's part shows FBL 0.4: the first pin creates view and placements together and unpinning removes both, the switch creates view by itself, and a pin and a fold then add placements and groups at the end of view. All of it is undone back to the template and one edit redone.

steps.doc: Opening and saving without an edit writes the bytes that were read.
steps.expect: agent-activity-diagram: 1

steps.doc: The first project creates projects: at the end of the file (insert.create, end-of-document).
steps.expect:
agent-activity-diagram: 1
projects:
  - id: p-notion
    name: etalii.adp.ide.notion

steps.doc: The first specification creates specifications: at the end of the file; its project is a reference by id.

- id: s-addon
    project: p-notion
    name: Hype cycle add-on
    status: pending

specifications:

steps.doc: The first task of a specification creates its tasks: right after its status (create: after status).

steps.doc: The first pin creates both missing levels, view: at the end of the file and placements: inside it, one ensure-container splice each, outermost first, then the entry (FBL 0.4, create at end).

agent-activity-diagram: 1

view:
  placements:

      x: 0
      y: 0

steps.doc: Unpinning it leaves placements: empty and view: with it, so both are removed, outermost first, before the entry (remove-empty-levels).
